title: CutItOut — an open-source AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser  #github
description:
Need to remove image backgrounds instantly — without uploading your photos anywhere? Meet CutItOut — an open-source AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser. CutItOut uses the powerful U²-Net deep learning model, running via WebAssembly and ONNX, so your images never leave your device. 

https://github.com/Suvink/cut-it-out

#github #opensource
